projectTitle: SHELLter — capturing cisplatin from patient urine with a chelator made from shellfish waste
projectTitle_zh: SHELLter — 以甲殼廢料製成的螯合劑，從病人尿液中捕捉順鉑
tagline: A point-of-care cartridge that chelates platinum chemotherapy drugs out of patient urine, with the chelator made enzymatically from crab shell.
tagline_zh: 一個在照護現場使用的濾匣，把鉑類化療藥物從病人尿液中螯合出來，而螯合劑本身是以酵素從蟹殼製造的。
summary: About half of each cisplatin dose leaves the patient in urine within days, and UK hospital effluent is not treated for cytotoxics at all. SHELLter intercepts it at the point of care with a monoacetylchitosan chelating ligand produced from shellfish-processing waste by an engineered SmChiA-VcCDA fusion enzyme. The dry lab is presented as four Python files on an interactive laptop — kinetic_model.py, docking_simulation.py, life_cycle_assessment.py and techno_economic_analysis.py — and all four feed each other: the kinetic model sets reaction conditions and predicts how downstream purification affects product yield, that yield drives the techno-economic cost per gram, and the same mass balance underpins the openLCA life cycle assessment. The docking study is a rigorously controlled computational experiment with negative controls, a pre-specified acceptance rule, multiple-comparison correction and a stated power analysis.
summary_zh: 每一劑順鉑約有一半會在數天內隨尿液離開病人體內，而英國醫院的廢水完全沒有針對細胞毒性藥物做處理。SHELLter 在照護現場就把它攔下來，使用的是以單乙醯幾丁聚醣為基礎的螯合配體，由改造過的 SmChiA-VcCDA 融合酵素以甲殼加工廢料製成。乾實驗室被呈現為一台互動式筆電上的四個 Python 檔案——kinetic_model.py、docking_simulation.py、life_cycle_assessment.py 與 techno_economic_analysis.py——而且四者互相餵養：動力學模型決定反應條件，並預測下游純化如何影響產物產率；該產率驅動技術經濟分析的每公克成本；同一份質量平衡也支撐起 openLCA 的生命週期評估。對接研究則是一個控制嚴謹的計算實驗，具備負對照、事先訂好的接受準則、多重比較校正，以及明確的檢定力分析。

dry.frameworks: Four models, deliberately coupled. (1) KINETIC MODEL — a mechanistic ODE system rather than an empirical fit, chosen precisely because the fusion enzyme is novel and PpChi is barely characterised, so no dataset exists to fit against. It is built from inhibited Michaelis-Menten forms: competitive inhibition for product rebinding, and noncompetitive inhibition for process impurities where, lacking any single inhibition constant for a mixture, they substitute chitin's measured protein-holding capacity (Cm = 0.032573 g/g) times substrate concentration as the rate-limiting term, giving dP/dt = kcat*ET*S / [Km(1 + I/Ki + D/(Cm*S)) + S(1 + D/(Cm*S))]. SmChiA's non-Michaelian processive mechanism on insoluble chitin is handled by converting polymer mass to N-acetylglucosamine residues (R0 = S0/203 g/mol), and PpChi's substrate is converted to GlcN-GlcN-GlcNAc motifs with the motif yield derived from degree of acetylation, Y = DA(1-DA)^2, and an average residue weight W = DA*203 + (1-DA)*161. Environmental dependence is interpolated with double-sigmoid rate modifiers for pH (F) and temperature (G) multiplying kcat, with all nine fitted sigmoid constants tabulated per enzyme, and thermal enzyme decay modelled with Bigelow's law. Twelve assumptions are tabulated with their impact AND their limitation, and the most influential are tested in a dedicated Choice Sensitivity section. (2) DOCKING SIMULATION — a ten-stage pipeline built as a controlled experiment, which is what makes it exceptional. Four fusion constructs (varying only the two things literature could not settle: domain order and His-tag terminus; all 1015 residues, GGGGSGGGGS inter-domain linker, GGGGS tag linker, native signal peptides retained) were each predicted five times by AlphaFold 3 with different seeds, giving twenty structures. Two design rules govern everything: every measurement is a difference taken WITHIN a single predicted structure, never between structures, because across seeds the CDA domain moved 25.6 +/- 11.0 Angstrom relative to ChiA so a between-structure comparison would measure AlphaFold rather than the protein; and every effect is measured against an apo' control in which the stochastic relaxation is re-run with nothing changed but the random seed, giving a genuine noise floor. Active-site residues were MEASURED rather than quoted: heavy atoms within 4.5 Angstrom of a bound chito-oligosaccharide across multiple crystal structures (1EHN, 1NH6 for SmChiA; 4NZ1, 4NZ3, 4OUI for VcCDA, 98.7-99.8% identity), with a residue required to appear in at least two independent structures, a 6.0 Angstrom criterion defining the mobile cleft, ligands under ten heavy atoms ignored to exclude buffer and cryoprotectant, and SIX NEGATIVE-CONTROL structures expected to return nothing, which returned zero contacts. Relaxation is Rosetta FastRelax under ref2015 via PyRosetta, five rounds, with a movemap freeing only the ~400 residues within 10 Angstrom of either cleft, computed once per replicate from the apo structure and reused unchanged across all four conditions so that apo and holo are compared over an identical mobile set. Substrates (tetraacetylchitotetraose, 57 heavy atoms, for the chitinase groove; diacetylchitobiose, 29 heavy atoms, for the deacetylase pocket) were built from PubChem with RDKit, parameterised with Meeko, and verified atom by atom. Docking is AutoDock Vina at exhaustiveness 32 with three independent seeds per receptor-substrate pair, 148 searches total, into a box centred on the contacting residues padded 6 Angstrom and clamped 18-32 Angstrom with a guard flagging any box centre more than 5 Angstrom from the cleft centroid. (3) LIFE CYCLE ASSESSMENT — a cradle-to-use LCA of four process steps (chitin extraction from shellfish waste, fusion production in E. coli, ligand production, device use), built in two independent halves that must agree: a component mass balance tracking every stream in every unit operation, and an openLCA model reproducing that arithmetic separately. Functional unit is one treatment course: one patient, five cycles, five cartridges per cycle, 60 kg of urine carrying 0.336 g of drug, with the baseline being the status quo of untreated discharge. (4) TECHNO-ECONOMIC MODEL — built on the same central mass balance, with a localised impurity-prediction part that feeds back into project design and a full cost-of-goods and discounted-cash-flow analysis.
dry.frameworks_zh: 四個模型，刻意互相耦合。（1）動力學模型：一組機制性的 ODE 系統，而不是經驗式擬合；之所以這樣選，正是因為這個融合酵素是全新的，而 PpChi 幾乎沒有被表徵過，根本沒有資料集可以拿來擬合。模型以帶抑制的 Michaelis-Menten 形式建立：產物再結合採競爭性抑制，製程雜質採非競爭性抑制；由於混合物沒有單一的抑制常數可用，他們改以幾丁質實測的蛋白吸附容量（Cm = 0.032573 g/g）乘上基質濃度作為限速項，得到 dP/dt = kcat*ET*S / [Km(1 + I/Ki + D/(Cm*S)) + S(1 + D/(Cm*S))]。SmChiA 在不溶性幾丁質上非 Michaelis 式的連續作用機制，以把高分子質量換算成 N-乙醯葡萄糖胺殘基（R0 = S0/203 g/mol）來處理；PpChi 的基質則換算成 GlcN-GlcN-GlcNAc 模式單元，其產率由乙醯化度推得，Y = DA(1-DA)^2，平均殘基分子量 W = DA*203 + (1-DA)*161。環境依賴性以 pH（F）與溫度（G）的雙 S 形速率修正因子內插，兩者乘上 kcat，每一種酵素所擬合的九個 S 形常數都列表呈現；酵素的熱衰減則以 Bigelow 定律建模。十二項假設都列表呈現，同時寫出它的影響與它的限制，而影響最大的幾項則在專門的選擇敏感度章節中加以檢驗。（2）對接模擬：一條十階段的流程，被當成一個受控實驗來設計，這正是它出色的原因。四種融合構築（只變動文獻無法定案的兩件事：結構域順序與 His-tag 放在哪一端；全長皆為 1015 個殘基，結構域間連接子為 GGGGSGGGGS，標籤連接子為 GGGGS，並保留原生訊號胜肽）各以不同隨機種子用 AlphaFold 3 預測五次，共得到二十個結構。有兩條設計規則貫穿全局：每一項量測都是在同一個預測結構內部取差值，絕不跨結構比較，因為在不同種子之間，CDA 結構域相對於 ChiA 移動了 25.6 ± 11.0 埃，跨結構比較量到的會是 AlphaFold 而不是蛋白質本身；而每一項效應都要對照一組 apo' 對照，也就是只改隨機種子、其他完全不變地重跑一次隨機鬆弛，藉此得到真正的雜訊底線。活性位殘基是量出來的，不是引用來的：在多個晶體結構中（SmChiA 用 1EHN、1NH6；VcCDA 用 4NZ1、4NZ3、4OUI，相似度 98.7-99.8%）取距離已結合幾丁寡醣 4.5 埃以內的重原子，並要求一個殘基至少出現在兩個獨立結構中；以 6.0 埃的標準界定可動的裂隙；忽略重原子少於十個的配體，以排除緩衝液與冷凍保護劑；另外設置六個預期應該什麼都不回傳的負對照結構，結果確實回傳零接觸。鬆弛使用透過 PyRosetta 執行、以 ref2015 評分函數的 Rosetta FastRelax，跑五輪，movemap 只釋放兩個裂隙任一側 10 埃以內的約 400 個殘基；這個 movemap 針對每個重複由 apo 結構計算一次，並在全部四種條件下原封不動重複使用，讓 apo 與 holo 在完全相同的可動殘基集合上比較。基質（幾丁質酶溝槽用四乙醯幾丁四醣，57 個重原子；去乙醯酶口袋用二乙醯幾丁二醣，29 個重原子）以 RDKit 從 PubChem 建構、用 Meeko 參數化，並逐一原子核對。對接使用 AutoDock Vina，exhaustiveness 設 32，每一組受體與基質配對跑三個獨立種子，總共 148 次搜尋；搜尋盒以接觸殘基為中心、外擴 6 埃，並限制在 18-32 埃之間，另設一道檢核，只要盒子中心離裂隙質心超過 5 埃就會被標示出來。（3）生命週期評估：一份從搖籃到使用階段的 LCA，涵蓋四個製程步驟（從甲殼廢料萃取幾丁質、在 E. coli 中生產融合酵素、生產配體、裝置使用），並以兩個必須互相吻合的獨立半邊建立：一份逐一追蹤每個單元操作中每一股物流的成分質量平衡，以及一個獨立重現同一套算術的 openLCA 模型。功能單位是一個療程：一位病人、五個週期、每週期五個濾匣、60 kg 尿液中帶有 0.336 g 藥物，基線則是現狀，也就是未經處理直接排放。（4）技術經濟模型：建立在同一份核心質量平衡上，另有一個局部的雜質預測部分會回饋到專案設計，並包含完整的製造成本與折現現金流分析。
dry.dataviz: The model landing page is an interactive laptop whose screen lists the four models as Python filenames, which the reader clicks to open — a small piece of framing that tells the reader immediately that the dry lab is four programs, not one vague 'model'. The kinetic results are presented as parameter sweeps with the optimum marked by a dot on each curve: time to 50% and 90% substrate conversion against temperature for each enzyme separately (PpChi 45 C, SmChiA 43 C, VcCDA 39 C) and a two-dimensional temperature-by-pH heatmap for the fusion (optimum 43 C, pH 6.1) drawn in the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe palette with darker colours for faster conversion — the team say so in the caption. Figure 20 is the decisive one: an enzyme molar-ratio sweep from 0.1 to 40 at constant total enzyme mass, showing a 15:1 SmChiA:VcCDA optimum roughly twice as fast as the 1:1 ratio a fusion is structurally locked into. The docking pipeline is drawn as a ten-stage flow diagram where each box names the stage, what it does and the software used, with stage 0 (measuring active sites from crystal structures) and stage 3 (building substrates from PubChem) shown as completing before the work they feed. Structures are shown in an embedded 3Dmol.js v2.5.5 viewer with a toggle between colour-by-part and colour-by-pLDDT confidence, and every AlphaFold figure caption carries the warning 'NOT experimentally determined or validated'. The LCA opens with a calibrated comparison instead of an abstract number: one SHELLter course emits 19.76 kg CO2eq, about 36 caffe lattes, 2.1 CT scans or one chemotherapy cycle — immediately followed by a note that these equivalence figures come from papers using different impact methods and databases and are 'given only for contextual perspective'.
dry.dataviz_zh: 模型首頁是一台互動式筆電，螢幕上以 Python 檔名列出四個模型，讀者點擊即可開啟；這個小小的呈現方式立刻告訴讀者，乾實驗室是四個程式，而不是一個含糊的「模型」。動力學結果以參數掃描呈現，每條曲線上都用一個點標出最佳值：各酵素分別的基質轉換達 50% 與 90% 所需時間對溫度作圖（PpChi 45 C、SmChiA 43 C、VcCDA 39 C），以及融合酵素的溫度對 pH 二維熱圖（最佳點 43 C、pH 6.1），採用對色盲友善的 Okabe-Ito 色盤，顏色越深代表轉換越快；團隊在圖說中也說明了這一點。圖 20 是最關鍵的一張：在總酵素質量固定的條件下，把酵素莫耳比從 0.1 掃到 40，顯示 SmChiA 比 VcCDA 為 15:1 時最佳，速度約為融合蛋白在結構上被鎖定的 1:1 比例的兩倍。對接流程畫成一張十階段流程圖，每個方塊都寫出階段名稱、做什麼以及使用的軟體，並把階段 0（從晶體結構量測活性位）與階段 3（從 PubChem 建構基質）畫成在它們所餵養的工作之前就已完成。結構以內嵌的 3Dmol.js v2.5.5 檢視器呈現，可切換依部位上色或依 pLDDT 信賴度上色，而每一張 AlphaFold 圖的圖說都附上警語：並非由實驗測定或驗證。LCA 一開始不是給一個抽象數字，而是給一個有校準的比較：一個 SHELLter 療程排放 19.76 kg CO2eq，大約等於 36 杯拿鐵、2.1 次電腦斷層掃描，或一個化療週期；緊接著就註明這些等價數字來自使用不同衝擊評估方法與資料庫的論文，只是為了提供脈絡上的參照。
dry.datascience: The statistical design of the docking study is the standout. The initial pose-convergence test (maximum pairwise RMSD across seeds) was found to conflate two different failure modes — seeds genuinely scattering versus a majority agreeing with one outlier — and was replaced mid-run with a rule written down BEFORE the run finished and then applied uniformly: a pose is accepted only if a strict majority of seeds agree within 2.0 Angstrom, the best-scoring pose falls inside that majority, at least 60% of its heavy atoms lie within 5 Angstrom of the cleft, and it clears every face of the search box by at least 1 Angstrom; every non-unanimous replicate got two further seeds. Results are reported with explicit counts and the honest verdict for each of five pre-set questions: both sites still bind (35 of 40 dockings accepted); each site responds structurally to its OWN substrate and not the other (25 of 32 paired comparisons, p = 0.0021, with Holm-Bonferroni correction cited); both sites can be occupied simultaneously (16 of 20 replicates); occupying one site produces no detectable effect at the other by three independent measurements, with the effect size BOUNDED below the apo' noise floor and the Rosetta additivity residual below ~4 REU; and domain order is reported as 'Not resolved at this sample size' with the explicit gloss that this means insufficient power, not absence of an effect. They then do the power analysis properly: at 9-12 replicates per group the null can only be rejected on unanimity, at 16 one may disagree, at 20 three may, so twenty per group is where the design starts to be able to detect what it currently cannot — with the per-step compute cost given (7.4 min per ligand docking, 16-24 min per relaxation on four cores) so the extension is actionable. Ten numbered assumptions are tabulated with impact and limitation, including that the VcCDA catalytic Zn2+ is simply absent from predicted structures (which they offer as the likely cause of DACB poses sitting partly off the pocket), that Vina affinities 'should be read as a ranking aid, not as delta-G', and that the docking score's 8 Angstrom interatomic cutoff could not register a direct 34-47 Angstrom cross-site interaction even if one existed — which is precisely why they also ran the cutoff-free Rosetta additivity test. The models genuinely changed decisions: the kinetic model's 15:1 ratio finding and the fusion-vs-dual-enzyme-vs-PpChi comparison table (time to 90% conversion: fusion 2.05 h, dual single-pot 1.17 h, dual multi-pot 1.84 h, PpChi 12.68 h) reframed the construct choice; the impurity model showed that going from 6 to 8 downstream unit operations nearly doubled product at 10 hours (11.44 to 22.40 mM), and feeding that into the TEA gave a cost per gram of chitobiose for each of five flowsheets (78.66, 84.57, 59.98, 172.62, 180.01 GBP/g), selecting PEG precipitation over chromatography on the reasoning that the fusion is not a biopharmaceutical so its purity target exists only to improve function. The DCF analysis, solved with GoalSeek to NPV = 0 at a 12% discount rate, gives a 17-year payback and a unit price of GBP 146.45, contextualised as ~1.9% of the GBP 7,670 NHS cost of treating one patient with systemic anti-cancer therapy.
dry.datascience_zh: 對接研究的統計設計是最突出的一點。最初的姿態收斂檢驗（跨種子的最大兩兩 RMSD）被發現會把兩種不同的失敗模式混為一談：種子真的四散，與多數一致但有一個離群值；於是在執行過程中換成另一條規則，而這條規則是在整批執行結束之前就先寫下來、之後一律適用：一個姿態只有在超過半數的種子彼此落在 2.0 埃以內、得分最佳的姿態也落在這個多數之中、其重原子至少 60% 位於裂隙 5 埃以內、而且與搜尋盒的每一個面都至少保留 1 埃距離時，才會被接受；凡是沒有全體一致的重複，都再加跑兩個種子。結果都附上明確的計數，並對五個事先設定的問題各自給出誠實的判斷：兩個活性位仍然會結合（40 次對接中接受 35 次）；每個活性位只對自己的基質產生結構反應，而不是對另一個（32 組配對比較中有 25 組，p = 0.0021，並引用 Holm-Bonferroni 校正）；兩個活性位可以同時被佔據（20 個重複中有 16 個）；佔據其中一個活性位，以三種獨立量測都偵測不到對另一個的影響，效應量被界定在 apo' 雜訊底線之下，Rosetta 的加成性殘差也低於約 4 REU；至於結構域順序，則回報為在這個樣本數下無法定論，並明確說明這代表檢定力不足，而不是沒有效應。接著他們把檢定力分析做得很紮實：每組 9-12 個重複時，只有全體一致才能拒絕虛無假設；16 個時可以容許一個不一致；20 個時可以容許三個，所以每組二十個才是這個設計開始能偵測到目前偵測不到的東西的地方；他們也給出每一步的運算成本（每次配體對接 7.4 分鐘，四核心上每次鬆弛 16-24 分鐘），讓後續的延伸真的可以執行。十項編號的假設都列表附上影響與限制，包括：預測結構中根本沒有 VcCDA 的催化 Zn2+（他們認為這很可能就是 DACB 姿態部分落在口袋外的原因）；Vina 的親和力數值應該被當成排序的輔助，而不是 delta-G；以及對接評分的 8 埃原子間截斷距離，即使真有一個橫跨 34-47 埃的跨活性位交互作用也偵測不到——這正是他們另外做了不設截斷距離的 Rosetta 加成性檢驗的原因。這些模型真的改變了決策：動力學模型 15:1 的比例結論，以及融合酵素對雙酵素對 PpChi 的比較表（達 90% 轉換所需時間：融合 2.05 小時、雙酵素單鍋 1.17 小時、雙酵素多鍋 1.84 小時、PpChi 12.68 小時），重新框定了構築的選擇；雜質模型顯示下游單元操作從 6 個增加到 8 個，可讓 10 小時的產物量幾乎倍增（11.44 到 22.40 mM），把這個結果餵進技術經濟分析後，得出五種流程方案各自的每公克幾丁二醣成本（78.66、84.57、59.98、172.62、180.01 英鎊／公克），並選擇 PEG 沉澱而非層析，理由是這個融合酵素不是生物藥品，純度目標的存在只是為了改善功能。折現現金流分析以 GoalSeek 在 12% 折現率下求解到 NPV = 0，得到 17 年回收期與每單位 146.45 英鎊的價格，並放在脈絡中說明：這大約是 NHS 為一位病人施行全身性抗癌治療 7,670 英鎊成本的 1.9%。
dry.software: The kinetic model is released on the team's software GitLab at gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/ucl/model. The docking pipeline is parameterised and scripted end to end, which is what makes the stated extension (add seeds, re-run the same scripts) credible. Structures are presented in-browser with 3Dmol.js v2.5.5 (BSD-3-Clause) with a pLDDT colouring toggle. The LCA is built in openLCA alongside an independent spreadsheet mass balance as a cross-check.
dry.software_zh: 動力學模型釋出在團隊的軟體 GitLab：gitlab.igem.org/2026/software/ucl/model。對接流程從頭到尾都參數化並寫成腳本，這也是他們所提延伸做法（加種子、重跑同一批腳本）之所以可信的原因。結構以 3Dmol.js v2.5.5（BSD-3-Clause）在瀏覽器中呈現，並可切換 pLDDT 上色。LCA 以 openLCA 建立，並以一份獨立的試算表質量平衡作為交叉檢查。
techniques: competitive and noncompetitive inhibited Michaelis-Menten kinetics
double-sigmoid environmental rate modifiers for pH and temperature
multi-dimensional parameter sweeps for process optimisation
enzyme ratio optimisation / rate-limiting step identification

good.publicEngagement: An education programme with its own substantial page, built around two recurring illustrated characters (Cisplatin and Shelly) who appear throughout the wiki, including in the loading animation — a consistent visual voice that makes a technical oncology-waste project approachable. The team's public-facing identity extends to Instagram and a LinkedIn company page for SHELLter.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 教育工作有自己一個篇幅不小的頁面，建立在兩個反覆出現的插畫角色上（Cisplatin 與 Shelly），它們出現在整個 wiki 中，連載入動畫也有；這種一致的視覺語調，讓一個技術性的腫瘤科廢棄物專案變得親切。團隊對外的身分也延伸到 Instagram，以及 SHELLter 的 LinkedIn 公司頁面。
good.ihp: The strongest part of the project's non-technical work, and genuinely regulatory rather than decorative. Conversations with NHS England's healthcare and sustainability teams uncovered a specific, exploitable regulatory gap: Water UK forbids direct discharge of cytotoxic and cytostatic medications to foul sewers under any circumstances, including rinsing their containers, but patient bodily discharges containing 'metabolised medications' are permitted — while the actual degree of metabolism varies from 10-97%, giving patient discharge rates of roughly 3-90%, so metabolic-rate statistics can be selected to bypass waste-management rules. Dr Anne Woolridge explained that England's focus is on protecting personnel from cytotoxic exposure rather than downstream treatment, visible in the Pan London Cytotoxic Policy; the team then cite evidence that even tertiary membrane-bioreactor treatment removes only up to 51% of hydrophilic cisplatin, and that 22% of platinum compounds were detected in the outflows of a major UK hospital (Derriford, Plymouth) after conventional treatment. Anne O'Connor and Dr Kumud Kantilal established why point-of-care capture is the right intervention: outpatient chemotherapy is becoming the norm, but patient bodily fluids remain hazardous for up to seven days after discharge, so a large fraction of excreted cytotoxic residue can never reach any hospital treatment system. Joe Burton and Dr Sharon Pfleger surfaced a gap in NHS clinical-waste sustainability priorities. Stakeholders including Dr Jay Burt, Professor Louis Grandjean, Dr Anne Woolridge, Professor Laurence Lovat, Dr Sophie Fridman and Alex Senechal independently asked for the economic case, which is explicitly why the techno-economic model exists and why it is structured to produce a cost per unit of environmental benefit.
good.ihp_zh: 這是整個專案非技術工作中最強的部分，而且是真的在處理法規，不是裝飾。與 NHS England 的醫療與永續團隊對話，讓他們發現一個具體而可切入的法規缺口：Water UK 在任何情況下都禁止把細胞毒性與細胞抑制類藥物直接排入污水下水道，連沖洗容器也不行，但含有已代謝藥物的病人排泄物卻是允許的；而實際的代謝程度在 10-97% 之間變動，病人排出的比例因此大約在 3-90%，意思是只要挑選合適的代謝率統計數字，就能繞過廢棄物管理規定。Dr Anne Woolridge 說明英格蘭的重點放在保護人員不受細胞毒性藥物暴露，而不是下游處理，這在 Pan London Cytotoxic Policy 中看得很清楚；團隊接著引用證據指出，即使是三級的膜生物反應器處理，對親水性順鉑的去除率也只到 51%，而英國一家大型醫院（Plymouth 的 Derriford）在常規處理後的排放水中仍檢出 22% 的鉑化合物。Anne O'Connor 與 Dr Kumud Kantilal 則確立了為什麼照護現場捕捉才是正確的介入點：門診化療正在成為常態，但病人的體液在離院後最長七天內仍具危害性，因此有很大一部分排出的細胞毒性殘留根本不可能進入任何醫院的處理系統。Joe Burton 與 Dr Sharon Pfleger 指出 NHS 臨床廢棄物永續優先順序中的一個缺口。包括 Dr Jay Burt、Professor Louis Grandjean、Dr Anne Woolridge、Professor Laurence Lovat、Dr Sophie Fridman 與 Alex Senechal 在內的利害關係人都各自要求看經濟論證，這正是技術經濟模型存在的原因，也是它被設計成要產出每單位環境效益的成本的原因。
good.realWorld: The commercial and environmental case is quantified rather than asserted. The LCA's functional unit is a real clinical course (one patient, five cycles, fifteen cartridges, 60 kg of urine carrying 0.336 g of drug) measured against the actual status quo of untreated discharge, and the headline is framed as a trade: 19.76 kg CO2eq to prevent an emission that currently happens unchecked, roughly a fifth added to the ~100 kg CO2eq of the five-cycle treatment it cleans up. The objective is stated as ecotoxicity avoided per unit of climate and energy burden, with unit operations ranked by their contribution to each impact category. The techno-economic model selects the full nine-step downstream train (centrifugation, resuspension, homogenisation, flocculation, centrifugation, depth filtration, PEG precipitation, tangential flow filtration, resolubilisation) on cost-per-gram grounds, and gives a sellable unit price of GBP 146.45 at NPV = 0 with a 17-year payback, deliberately benchmarked against NHS treatment cost. The feedstock is shellfish-processing waste, which makes the chelator itself a valorised waste stream.
good.realWorld_zh: 商業與環境論證是算出來的，不是喊出來的。LCA 的功能單位是一個真實的臨床療程（一位病人、五個週期、十五個濾匣、60 kg 尿液中帶有 0.336 g 藥物），對照的是未經處理直接排放的實際現狀，而結論被框定成一筆交換：付出 19.76 kg CO2eq，去阻止一筆目前完全沒有被攔截的排放，相當於在這個五週期療程本身約 100 kg CO2eq 之上再加約五分之一。他們把目標表述為每單位氣候與能源負擔所避免的生態毒性，並依各單元操作對每一個衝擊類別的貢獻度排序。技術經濟模型以每公克成本為依據，選定完整的九步下游流程（離心、再懸浮、均質、絮凝、離心、深層過濾、PEG 沉澱、切向流過濾、再溶解），並得出在 NPV = 0 時可販售的單位價格 146.45 英鎊、回收期 17 年，而且刻意與 NHS 的治療成本對比。原料是甲殼加工廢料，這讓螯合劑本身也成為一條被加值利用的廢棄物流。
partners: NHS England healthcare and sustainability teams

images.caption: The ten-stage docking pipeline, with each box naming the stage, what it does and the software used. Stage 0 defines the active sites by measuring them from substrate-bound crystal structures independently of any model built later, and stage 3 builds and verifies the substrates from PubChem — both complete before the work they feed into begins.
images.caption_zh: 十階段的對接流程，每個方塊都寫出階段名稱、做什麼以及使用的軟體。階段 0 以量測的方式從結合基質的晶體結構界定活性位，獨立於之後建立的任何模型；階段 3 則從 PubChem 建構並核對基質；兩者都在它們所餵養的工作開始之前就已完成。

images.caption: Figure 20: the enzyme-ratio parameter sweep that settled a construct decision. Holding total enzyme mass constant at 0.111 g/L, the SmChiA:VcCDA ratio was swept from 0.1 to 40; the 90%-conversion optimum sits at 15:1, roughly twice as fast as the 1:1 ratio a fusion protein is structurally locked into, identifying SmChiA as the rate-limiting step.
images.caption_zh: 圖 20：決定了構築選擇的酵素比例參數掃描。在總酵素質量固定為 0.111 g/L 的條件下，SmChiA 比 VcCDA 的比例從 0.1 掃到 40；達 90% 轉換的最佳點落在 15:1，約為融合蛋白在結構上被鎖定的 1:1 比例的兩倍快，也指出 SmChiA 才是限速步驟。

images.caption: Figure 18: time to 50% and 90% substrate conversion for the fusion enzyme across temperature and pH, drawn in the Okabe-Ito colour-blind-safe palette with darker colours for faster conversion and a dot marking the optimum (43 C, pH 6.1). The surface shows the fusion optimum is weighted far more toward SmChiA than VcCDA.
images.caption_zh: 圖 18：融合酵素在不同溫度與 pH 下，基質轉換達 50% 與 90% 所需的時間，採用對色盲友善的 Okabe-Ito 色盤，顏色越深代表轉換越快，並以一個點標出最佳條件（43 C、pH 6.1）。這個曲面顯示融合酵素的最佳條件明顯更偏向 SmChiA，而不是 VcCDA。

images.caption: AlphaFold 3 model of the ChiA-CDA-His fusion, coloured by prediction confidence: two compact well-predicted domains with an extended low-confidence loop arcing above them. The team use this honestly — because the CDA domain moved 25.6 +/- 11.0 Angstrom relative to ChiA across five seeds, every measurement in the study is a difference taken within a single structure rather than between them.
images.caption_zh: ChiA-CDA-His 融合蛋白的 AlphaFold 3 模型，依預測信賴度上色：兩個結構緊密、預測良好的結構域，上方則有一段延展的低信賴度環。團隊對它的使用很誠實——由於 CDA 結構域在五個種子之間相對於 ChiA 移動了 25.6 ± 11.0 埃，整個研究中每一項量測都是在單一結構內部取差值，而不是在結構之間比較。

gemsTakeaway: Run a computational study as a real experiment: define your measurement target by measuring it (active-site residues from crystal structures, with negative controls that must return nothing) rather than quoting a number, include a do-nothing control that captures the method's own noise (re-run the stochastic relaxation with only the seed changed), write the acceptance rule down before you finish the run, and when a comparison fails to reach significance say 'not resolved at this sample size' and state how many replicates would be needed.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 把計算研究當成真正的實驗來做：用量測來定義你的量測標的（從晶體結構量出活性位殘基，並設置應該什麼都不回傳的負對照），而不是引用一個數字；放進一個什麼都不改的對照，用來捕捉方法本身的雜訊（只改隨機種子、重跑一次隨機鬆弛）；在整批執行結束之前就先把接受準則寫下來；而當一項比較沒有達到顯著時，就說在這個樣本數下無法定論，並說明還需要多少重複。
